post: Humbled to announce that our {seed.bare} team hit 98% of target. Agree?
I asked our team for 110% this quarter. They gave 97%. That's what leadership looks like.
Woke up at 4 a.m., ran 10 km, read three reports on {seed.generic}. Then I hugged my team. Grateful.
Proud of everyone at {company}. We didn't hit our numbers, but we missed them together.
Unpopular opinion: {seed.generic} and quarterly targets have a lot in common. Let that sink in.
Excited to share that {company} now puts {seed.generic} first. More soon.
Five things our {seed.bare} team taught me about resilience. Number four will surprise you.
Some ask why I start every meeting with a minute of silence for our targets. Leadership is lonely.
Our intern asked me what we do. I didn't have an answer. Then I did: {seed.generic}. Thank you, intern.
Closed the quarter with a team hug and a spreadsheet. Both were emotional.
